CustomField.description: Optional literal SOQL WHERE-clause fragment. If blank, the step always runs. If set, the step only runs when the target record matches this condition (e.g. RecordType.DeveloperName IN ('X','Y')) — otherwise it's skipped and the engine moves to the next step (or finishes the approval if this was the last one).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional literal SOQL WHERE-clause fragment evaluated against the target record. Leave blank for the step to always run.
CustomField.label: Entry Criteria
